test_title: PYST 39: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: At what rate (in percentage) per annum will ₹1,300 give ₹650 as simple interest in 10 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,300

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹650

Time (t) = 10 years

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/(100)

**Calculations:**

650 = (1300 × R × 10)/(100)

⇒ (650 × 100)/(1300 × 10) = R

⇒ (65000)/(13000) = R

⇒ R = 5%

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
